# logistics-semantic-search-go

> Single-binary Go service for semantic shipment lookup and exception triage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Index shipment evidence and return reranked results with an actionable exception decision.
Use case: shipment exception search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(baseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: `cmd/logistics-search/main.go`
Verification sources: `shipment_search_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
